loadError: Couldn't load the test. Check your connection and try again.

timer.label: Time remaining

unansweredCount: {count, plural, =0 {All questions answered} =1 {1 question unanswered} other {# questions unanswered}}

ordering.notAnswered: You haven't ordered the items yet.

nav.backLocked: You can't go back to previous questions in this test.

navigator.title: Questions

confirm.title: Submit the test?

confirm.submitFailed: Couldn't submit the test. Check your connection and try again.
